items.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Search Nepal Tunnel for Survivors After Finding 2 Alive
items.summary: Dozens of other people were believed to be trapped in a tunnel at a hydropower project since last week’s deadly flood, officials said. It was not clear how many were still alive.

items.title: The Battle to be Australia’s Best Pie
items.summary: A hot meat pie from any roadside bakery is a staple on a long Australian road trip, but what does it take to be crowned a winner?

items.title: For Russia and Ukraine, an Escalating Spiral With No End in Sight
items.summary: Each side is using missiles and drones to try to pound the other into giving up, breeding ceaseless human suffering. But there is no sign that either country’s determination will weaken.

items.title: Norway Seizes Russian Ship, Testing Moscow in the High Arctic
items.summary: Empowered by an international court order, Norway captured the vessel as part of a global effort to seize Russian assets. The Russians called it “piracy.”

items.title: How Do You Run for Office in a Gang War?

items.title: Spain’s Leader Questions Morocco Border Control During Ceuta Migrant Surge
items.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain said the role of Moroccan authorities at key moments needed to be “clarified.” But he rejected any suggestion they had planned the crisis.

items.title: Syrians Want Justice for Assad-Era Killings and Torture
items.summary: Hundreds of thousands were killed and tortured. But prosecuting everyone involved in atrocities could be impractical and risk renewed civil strife.

items.title: Israeli Military Kills Two Palestinian Youths in Village Raid, Residents Say

items.title: Rival Ukrainian Intelligence Units Open Fire Against Each Other in Kyiv

items.title: Israel Is Expected to Release Lebanese Prisoners, in Rare Sign of Progress

items.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Set New High

items.title: Former Labor Secretary Stoked Dysfunction and Toxicity, Department Report Finds

items.title: Tesla Begins Offering Rides in a Car Without a Steering Wheel
